title: Melee runtime audits (recorded ground truth)
description: Runtime-verified semantic facts about GALE01 rev2, recorded from the live game via Dolphin's GDB stub. Covers the external vs internal stage-ID spaces (grkind = internal ground-archive index, stkind = external stage-param index), the DOL's own 86-entry stage-name table (names decomp Unk slots), Venom platform-controller field verification (target_gobj, upper_jobj/lower_jobj, smash-taunt timer), and the 0x15/0x1A stage hard-freeze root cause. Data + reports only; audit scripts and Gecko payloads stay upstream.
